summary: Participants question whether this truly extends PME, which currently protects at module boundaries, and call for clarification of scope and implementation details. Participants decide to include Delta mode, rename the proposal to FastLanes, and plan future work on interleaving and Unified Transpose Layout. The proposal introduces a SERIALIZED_VALUE logical type for Parquet BYTE_ARRAY columns that hold serialized messages such as protobuf, FlatBuffers, or Thrift. By using a modular footer, the layout preserves row-group statistics for efficient data skipping while improving page sizing and reducing overhead for wide or sparse schemas.
